'''Gabriella Sanniti di Baja''' (born 29 January 1950) is a retired Italian computer scientist specializing in [[pattern recognition]], including [[digital geometry]] and [[Topological skeleton|skeletonization]].{{r|orcid}}

==Education and career==
Sanniti di Baja was a student at the [[University of Naples Federico II]], where she completed a doctorate in 1973.{{r|orcid}}

She worked for the [[National Research Council (Italy)|Italian National Research Council (CNR)]], affiliated with the Institute of Cybernetics "E. Caianiello".{{r|orcid}} In 2017, retiring as a director of research for the CNR, she was appointed as an affiliated researcher.{{r|retire}}

She is a former editor-in-chief of the journal ''[[Pattern Recognition Letters]]'',{{r|orcid}} and was president of the [[International Association for Pattern Recognition]] (IAPR) for the 2000–2002 term.{{r|piapr}}

==Recognition==
Sanniti di Baja was named as a Fellow of the IAPR in 1998, "for exceptional service to IAPR and for contributions to image analysis",{{r|fiapr}} She has a 2002 honorary doctorate from [[Uppsala University]], and became a foreign member of the [[Royal Society of Sciences in Uppsala]] in 2011.{{r|orcid}} She is also a Fellow of the International Academy of Artificial Intelligence Sciences.{{r|iaai}}
